-- Preserve immutable assignment correlations while mutable attempt status evolves.
CREATE FUNCTION student_lesson_answer_binding_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.learning_path_item_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_path_item_id OR NEW.requirement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requirement_id OR NEW.frozen_task_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.frozen_task_json THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'lesson assessment binding is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER student_lesson_answer_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON student_task_answer FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_lesson_answer_binding_immutable();
CREATE FUNCTION student_lesson_action_binding_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.learning_path_item_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_path_item_id OR NEW.requirement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requirement_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'lesson activity binding is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER student_lesson_action_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON student_learning_action FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_lesson_action_binding_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_lesson_activity_fact_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_lesson_activity_fact FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable();
